howTo.title: How do I submit a request?
howTo.intro: Three steps from signing in to receiving the official letter.
howTo.step1Title: Sign in with your university account
howTo.step1Body: Use your university email ending in @uoturath.edu.iq through the Google button.
howTo.step2Title: Fill in the request and upload the signed form
howTo.step2Body: Choose the request type, complete its details and upload the official form once it is signed by the responsible body.
howTo.step3Body: The request goes to the college dean, then Scientific Affairs, then the Vice President for Scientific Affairs, with a notification at every stage.

explain.what: Journals that charge researchers publication fees and promise fast review and international indexing, but provide no real peer review and no reliable indexing. Research published in them may not count towards promotion or appreciation letters, and is hard to withdraw and publish elsewhere.
explain.hijacked: A genuine, reputable journal whose name and ISSN fraudsters copy onto a fake website to collect papers and fees. A paper sent to the fake site is not published in the real journal and is not indexed with it.
explain.sign1: Acceptance within a few days without real reviewer comments.
explain.sign2: Unsolicited emails inviting you to publish or join the editorial board.
explain.sign3: Fees requested before review or right after acceptance, with pressure to pay quickly.
explain.sign4: Claimed impact factors or indexing that do not appear on the official Scopus or Web of Science sites.
explain.sign5: A weak website, or a name very close to a well-known journal's.
explain.sign6: A very broad scope that mixes unrelated fields.
explain.step1: Look the journal and publisher up in the lists linked below.
explain.step2: Check the journal's indexing on the official Scopus or Web of Science site, not on the journal's own site.
explain.step3: Compare the journal's web address with the one recorded in the databases to make sure it is not hijacked.
explain.step4: If in doubt, ask the scientific affairs department before you submit, not after.
